name: hok_minimap_dual_512_near_zone_dev
notes: Experimental dual-class near-zone candidate: v6 512 balanced checkpoint on safe dual-class v8 (train 194 images/512 boxes; pooled development val video2-HD+11+13, 129 images/328 boxes, used for model and threshold selection; test split empty). Development player P/R 95.45/90.32%, centre error P95 6.29 px; enemy P/R/F1 95.35/87.23/91.11%. These are not independent or release results. ONNX raw parity strict gate failed (0.000639 > 0.0005) with identical final detections; the ncnn Android-equivalent strict gate passed. events.min_confidence equals the lowest per-class detector threshold so the event engine does not filter a second time. minimap_relation.enter_radius is a provisional estimate until calibrated from screen-edge frames. Keep verified=false. The event observation-age budget is 500 ms, aligned with minimap_relation.max_freshness_ms: Android diagnostic inference exceeded the former 250 ms gate. Capture timestamps remain unchanged; observations older than 500 ms are still rejected.

calibration.method: median minimap distance, in map short-edge units, of about 20 frames where an enemy hero first enters the main-screen edge; exit_radius = 1.25 x enter_radius

user_adjustment.reason: Player reported excessive warning range; provisional 20% radius reduction, without a threshold sweep or independent calibration.
